every_position_composed.reason: Site 2 maintains a complete UI-plus-3D composition across all steps, whereas Site 1 drops the UI card entirely in transitional frames 4 and 7.

explains_the_project.reason: Both sites use the exact same clear 3D mechanical assembly line across frames 1-9 to illustrate log compression, local storage, and source anchoring.

craft_of_the_3d.reason: Both sites share the identical grounded, industrial 3D models, grid floor, and lighting across frames 1-9.

type_and_layout.reason: By hiding the text panel during camera travel in frames 4 and 7, Site 1 prevents the text card from colliding with close-up 3D machinery as happens in Site 2's frame 7.

overall.reason: Although nearly identical, Site 2 provides a steadier scroll experience by keeping the explanatory panel continuously visible during transitions rather than abruptly blanking out.
